fluff.overview: The Lyran Commonwealth's industrial wealth ensures its infantry are among the best-equipped in the Inner Sphere, fielding hardware that most armies reserve for elite formations as standard issue. Mechanized tracked platoons deploy from armored personnel carriers that provide protection during movement and allow the formation to keep pace with heavier combat vehicles in offensive operations. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable long-range missile launchers, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry weapon range, providing indirect fire support to the formation.
